> Clean by construction: quotation marks curled by an editor, which is what
> every word processor does by default. Near-miss for `tell-curly-quotes`.

The support lead put it plainly in the retro: “nobody reads the banner, they
read the error.” That matched what the logs showed. Of the four hundred
sessions that hit the banner last week, three clicked it.

So we moved the text into the error itself and deleted the banner. The ticket
volume for that flow dropped by about a third the following week, which is less
than we hoped and more than nothing.
